description: Stratified annotation queue for RECALL + HALLUCINATION judge calibration on the frozen post-GRPO paper run (eval_grpo_prio_20k, best.pt @ step 11800). 50 records total. This re-runs the Appendix G calibration loop on post-RL outputs so judge-vs-human kappa is directly comparable to the pre-RL 0.817 (coverage) / 0.705 (hallucination). Reports are pulled verbatim from the frozen weave.Evaluation predict_and_score traces (the exact generations behind Table 1) and re-emitted through itm_annotate with a primed predict cache, so no model is re-run and no GPU is needed. Coverage strata are weighted toward the attacked settings (AP/HO) and are otherwise REPRESENTATIVE within each setting (no coverage enrichment), so the coverage kappa stays comparable to the reported number. Hallucination is deliberately ENRICHED (require=halluc_flagged draws from the 48 records the judge flagged with >=1 hallucinated bullet, out of 1000; measured record-level flag rate 0.048) because a blind sample degenerates kappa under ~0.05 prevalence; the enrichment is stated openly and Gwet's AC2 is reported alongside kappa. The enriched stratum is sampled FIRST so it is guaranteed to fill; coverage strata then draw from the remaining pool (used_ids are never re-queued). require is one of: 'halluc_flagged' (max judge hallucination score > 0), 'any' (no outcome constraint).
